workarounds.symptom: Model server rejects assistant tool calls that carry `index` (OpenRouter), breaking the second agent turn
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(model): drop tool-call index from chat-completions requests. Target files: nemo_gym/core/responses_api_types.py, tests/unit_tests/core/test_responses_api_types.py, tests/unit_tests/models/test_chat_completions_streaming.py. OpenRouter returns `index` on each entry of an assistant message's `tool_calls`, even in non-streaming responses. Agents that send the assistant message back unchanged on the next turn, such as `mini_swe_agent_2` through litellm, include that key in their next chat-completions request. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/6484)

workarounds.symptom: Locked server environments lose explicit-index sources when a uv index variable is set
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix: keep explicit-index sources in the uv mirror sync. Target files: nemo_gym/server_runtime/supervisor/_locked_env.py, tests/unit_tests/server_runtime/supervisor/test_locked_env.py. When a uv index variable is set, `sync_environment` takes the `_sync_from_mirror` path. `uv export` drops the lock's per-package index sources, so packages pinned to an explicit index (e.g. `torch==2.6.0+cpu`) are looked up on the caller's indexes and fail to install. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/6355)

workarounds.symptom: [NVBug 6805516] Replace load_dataset with hf_hub_download in IF/reasoning_gym prepare
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(environments): copy the raw JSONL in instruction_following and reasoning_gym prepare. Target files: environments/instruction_following/prepare.py, environments/reasoning_gym/prepare.py, tests/unit_tests/test_jsonl_environment_prepare.py. `python environments/instruction_following/prepare.py` and `python environments/reasoning_gym/prepare.py`, the README steps that download each environment's training data, now write the published file. Before this change, both crashed inside Arrow before writing anything. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/5092)

workarounds.symptom: [NVBug 6900605] Re-enable pathspec for harbor_agent venv so Harbor rollouts stop silently scoring 0
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(harbor_agent): restore pathspec in the Harbor agent environment. Target files: responses_api_agents/harbor_agent/pyproject.toml, responses_api_agents/harbor_agent/tests/test_dependencies.py, responses_api_agents/harbor_agent/uv.lock. Restores `pathspec` in the `harbor_agent` environment. Harbor imports it through `dirhash` → `scantree`, but since #4193 the shared policy excludes it (`pathspec; sys_platform == 'never'`), so `from harbor.job import Job` raises `ModuleNotFoundError` and every Harbor rollout fails and scores 0. (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/5732)

workarounds.symptom: [NVBug 6847514] Declare transformers (and ship prompt YAMLs) so ns_tools prepare_dataset runs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(ns_tools): apply the generic/math prompt in prepare_dataset.py. Target files: resources_servers/ns_tools/prepare_dataset.py, resources_servers/ns_tools/prompts/generic/math.yaml, resources_servers/ns_tools/tests/test_prepare_dataset.py. The ns_tools README command that regenerates the comp-math data now runs and writes the `generic/math` prompt into every row. Before this change it either failed at import (`No module named 'transformers'`) or, with transformers installed, logged a warning per row and silently wrote the r... (Ref: https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Gym/pull/5335)
